notes.subject: באשים
notes.rationale: בְּאֻשִׁים — tok i stap long Tanakh hia tasol (wantaim 5:4); mining i no klia: 'ol grape nogut/sawa'.

notes.subject: ענבים/באשים
notes.rationale: Klais bilong gutpela grape na grape nogut — singsing i pulap long disapoinment; Tok Pisin i holim kontras tasol no nois.

notes.subject: gaden wainim
notes.rationale: Parabol — husait em i man bilong mi na husait gaden i no klia yet long v1–2; tok i stap tumbuna.

translation: Em i klinim graun bilong en na rausim ol ston bilong en, na planim gutpela wain, na bilim wanpela towa long namel bilong en, na karimim tu wanpela hap bilong kainapim wain long en. Em i wet long wokim ol grape gutpela, tasol en i wokim ol grape nogut.

tokens.gloss: em i klinim graun bilong en
na rausim ol ston bilong en
